description: This Java class defines an abstract base class for validating command sizes within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It checks whether certain size constraints are exceeded and throws exceptions accordingly, parametrized by the specific exception type.

classes.name: AbstractCommandSizeValidator
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for size validation of commands, ensuring they do not exceed specified limits, and throwing a specific exception type when limits are exceeded.

methods.name: AbstractCommandSizeValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the size validator with an optional maximum size.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the maximum allowed size, if any.

methods.name: ensureValidSize
methods.description: Checks if the actual size, obtained via a size supplier, exceeds the maximum size and throws an exception if it does.

methods.name: ensureValidSize (overloaded)
methods.description: Checks size against an upper bound, and delegates to the primary ensureValidSize if the upper bound exceeds the maximum size.

methods.name: newInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Abstract method to build a size violation exception with relevant details.
